notes.title: Game update: 2.3
notes.content:
Changes:
- added new PAT song: Kabát - Země plná trpaslíků (1995)
- added support for gamepads
- fixed PAT song "8:45 Heaven" where video was not closed in 3p mode
- fixed possible displaying too long control key names
- fixed end stats for 3p mode, where was wrongly computed bonuses
- not installed PAT song now displaying info message

Changes in the editor (2.2):
- added possibility to copy complete track to current edited track

notes.title: Game update: 2.1
notes.content:
Changes:
- upgrade from the Unreal Engine 4.20 to 4.24
- fixed sound/video desynchronization (lag) in the movies in the PAT songs (fixed by the new engine)

notes.title: Game update: 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Three player mode (3p)[/h1]
Now is possible to play with three players together on the selected songs (currently only the PAT songs). You can also play 3p songs alone and choose if you want to play only drums, only keyboard or only guitar.

Guitar is played little differently. You need to hold strings at any time and play them in the right moment (Enter key by default).

Changes:
- added three player mode
- added new PAT song: Drunken Tiger - 8:45 Heaven (2007)
- added new PAT song: James Brown - It's A Man's, Man's, Man's World (1966)
- many new features in the editor to support 3p

notes.title: Free to play mode will ends
notes.content:
This game will be changed from "free to play" to common paid model again. Free to play was an a experiment and result is that it is not suitable for this type of game from a indie developer.

Also the game will have faster loading, because all songs will be already inside.

Send your Steam key to aaagames@aaagames.cz (or any other proof of buying) and you will get keys for all DLCs for free.

notes.title: Game update: 1.3
notes.content:
Changes:
- win marker and control keys are not missplaced in different resolutions that 16:9
- fixed accessing null settings at start

notes.title: Game and editor update: 1.2
notes.content:
Main new feature is a PAT song support. The PAT song is only pattern of icons without music. To play it with music, you have to copy your mp4 with correct song to the game.

Changes:
- added support for PAT songs
- added one testing PAT song [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1G4isv_Fylg]Paradise[/url]

Changes in the editor:
- automatically adding empty page to new songs or when last page is deleted
- added recording feature (now you can record notes in realtime for better positioning)
- added PAT delay value (delay the pattern after a song is started to solve bug in Unreal Engine where playing videos have delayed sound)
- added possibility to run song without background music
- added possibility to set duration of song by hand (for PAT songs)
